name: Epoch-Bastion
geological_features: Stratified cliff faces showing deep geological time
description: Epoch-Bastion presents its history in layers visible to the naked eye. Cliff faces hundreds of meters tall display strata in vivid bands of ochre, slate, and crimson, each layer a chapter spanning millions of years of geological transformation.

The air is clean and carries the mineral tang of ancient stone. Winds sweep across the petrified plateaus with a low whistle, and the rivers run clear through limestone gorges that have been carved with patient precision over eons.

Deep in the oldest strata, survey teams have found what appear to be fossilized foundations of structures too regular to be natural. Whatever built them predates the planet's current fossil record by at least two billion years, suggesting a civilization that existed before complex life evolved here.

The discovery has attracted both archaeologists and prospectors, the former seeking to understand the impossible timeline and the latter drawn by rumors that the ancient builders left material caches within the stone. The thriving ecosystem above complicates extraction efforts considerably.
